note: Generated by tools/build-fight-value.py train (Part A gating). OFFLINE: not read by any decision code. Per segment of decision points (encounter; backed off to act x fight kind, then fight kind, then global, below 120 similar-state decision points): the fair same-state ranking test of blends of the fight-value model with the current turn-solver weights, against the current weights alone, on out-of-fold predictions, with a cluster-bootstrap CI; the model's blend weight w. Line value (HP-equivalent) = w x model value + (1 - w) x current value; model value = -own-turn HP loss - E[further HP loss] - 40 x (1 - calibrated win prob); current value = solver score / solver HP weight. Win probabilities: calibration per fight kind (none / isotonic knots / Platt), chosen by nested out-of-fold Brier. See notes/rollout-backtest.md.

params.formula: w = w_cap * n/(n+n0) * smoothstep(clamp(ci_lo/a_full, 0, 1)); n = rows; w_cap = grid weight with the highest ci_lo
